title: Staging shadow partition and guarded production promotion modes

phases.objective: Cover all 652 classified write routes with an explicit staging partition and four guarded modes while keeping every mutation and promotion disabled by default.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Shadow partition and promotion profile contract tests
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: All 652 routes are uniquely partitioned, shadow and staging modes remain non-mutating, and production-canary/production-live remain disabled behind explicit promotion prerequisites.
steps: Load the generated write-route inventory and assert that 652 classified write routes are present.
Verify each route is assigned to one safe staging bundle and one risk bucket.
Verify shadow and staging modes produce no database apply, provider call, credential payload read, or external send.
Verify production-canary and production-live are disabled and require allowlist, independent approval, TTL/quota, rollback/readback, kill switch, and production change approval before promotion.
Run both partition and profile contract tests with secrets and external mutations disabled.
assertions: All 652 write routes are covered exactly once.
The default request is false and every route requires approval, TTL, lease, rollback, and readback.
Shadow and staging modes do not execute mutations.
Production-canary and production-live cannot be activated by this PR or by default configuration.
No migration, provider call, OAuth/DCR registration, credential read, deployment, or Production mutation occurs.

phases.objective: Run shadow and staging acceptance with environment-bound evidence, durable receipts, rollback rehearsal, and same-cycle readback before any promotion.
Prove reconciliation, kill-switch behavior, lease expiry, quota enforcement, and failure recovery in a controlled non-Production environment.
Production-canary remains disabled until independent approval, route/resource allowlist, quota, rollback rehearsal, audit evidence, and environment authorization exist.
Production-live remains disabled and no real mutation is authorized by this PR.
